_doc: Active MCP servers. Only what a clean install needs; everything else lives in .mcp.json.template and is added with `python scripts/enable_mcp.py <name>`. Two invariants are load-bearing here: no `cmd /c` wrapper (it is Windows-only AND it re-parses the argv, so `mcp<2` became a shell redirect), and no absolute paths (a relative --script path resolves against the project root on every OS).

yahoo-finance._doc: Free, no API key. Primary market-data source. `--with mcp<2` is load-bearing: the upstream package imports mcp.server.fastmcp, which mcp 2.x deleted (FastMCP was renamed MCPServer). Without the pin the server dies at import and Claude Code reports -32000 Connection closed.

finnhub._doc: Custom thin Python MCP wrapping the Finnhub REST API. Replaces the broken npm finnhub-mcp (Windows path bug). Source: mcps/finnhub_mcp.py. Free tier 60 req/min.
